lane_artifact_checks: artifact exists and SHA-256 is frozen before review
source/file/time bound declared and not exceeded
no shared-state or prohibited action disclosed
explicit parent reply matches on-disk hash
claim_checks: one stable claim ID per material claim
primary or exact local locator and date/version
source fact is separated from BARAM migration hypothesis and local evidence needed
near_match_only never satisfies a transfer or performance claim

independent_validation.local_claims: root re-read exact bounded code/metadata lines and recompute file SHA; do not adopt child conclusions from narrative alone
independent_validation.external_claims: root fetch the cited primary source or official document for every design-critical claim; secondary snippets are navigation only
independent_validation.source_budget: validation fetches cited sources only and adds no new candidate source unless a new bounded lane is declared
independent_validation.contamination: discard any claim depending on prohibited label/2024/test/result exposure; disclose identifier-only incidents separately

synthesis_requirements: field-level diff from SK@v5 rather than concatenated lane reports
frozen S1-S4 foundation and active causal deficit
engine alternatives with minimal schema/test delta
Wave-B research questions frozen from Wave-A only
DS@v5 fingerprint and exact approval request
implementation_boundary: No source edit, fit, score or external data-body action until DS@v5 and IP@v3 exact approvals.
